description: A remote monitoring program manager must enroll one of three recently discharged heart-failure patients in the program's single available next-week opening and finalize the monitoring equipment, onboarding appointment, caregiver participation, and authorization record.

shared_context.S1: The hospital's remote heart-failure monitoring program has one available enrollment opening for next week.
shared_context.S2: The candidates are Jun Park, Kira Lewis, and Leo Martinez, and all three have been referred after recent heart-failure admissions.
shared_context.S3: The program uses connected blood-pressure and weight measurements, a scheduled onboarding appointment, and payer authorization before activation.
shared_context.S4: Maya makes the binding enrollment decision and records the operational plan.
shared_context.S5: At the weekly remote-monitoring huddle, the cardiology clinician, pharmacist, social worker, and utilization-management specialist each report relevant findings before Maya signs the enrollment plan.

PF1.text: Dr. Chen's review shows that Jun Park has had three heart-failure admissions in the last 30 days, so cardiology has assigned Jun the program's priority tier 1 for remote monitoring; the tier assignment is in Dr. Chen's referral worksheet but not yet in the program queue.

PF2.text: Luis confirmed that Jun Park's current medication-titration plan requires a Bluetooth blood-pressure cuff with twice-daily readings and a Bluetooth scale with daily readings; those are the exact connected devices needed for Jun's activation.

PF3.text: Jun Park's neighbor Elena can attend onboarding and then check the transmitted readings every morning from 07:00 to 07:15; Elena confirmed a Tuesday 15:30 onboarding appointment with Nia by phone.

PF4.text: The payer approved Jun Park's remote-monitoring enrollment under authorization code RPM-7314 for exactly 30 days, with the approval recorded in the utilization-management portal but not yet copied into the program record.

acceptance_conditions: Jun Park must receive the single enrollment opening because cardiology assigned Jun priority tier 1.
Jun's plan must specify a Bluetooth blood-pressure cuff with twice-daily readings and a Bluetooth scale with daily readings.
Onboarding must be scheduled for Tuesday at 15:30.
The plan must document Elena's daily 07:00-07:15 check of transmitted readings.
Authorization must be recorded as approved under code RPM-7314 for exactly 30 days.
Jun's priority-tier finding must be explicitly cited as justification.

content_checks.C2: decisions['blood_pressure_device'] in ['Bluetooth blood-pressure cuff with twice-daily readings', 'Bluetooth blood-pressure cuff (twice-daily readings)'] and decisions['weight_device'] in ['Bluetooth scale with daily readings', 'Bluetooth scale (daily readings)']
content_checks.C4: any(c['type'] == 'scheduling' and c['target'] == 'Tuesday 15:30 onboarding appointment' and c['detail'] == 'Confirm Tuesday 15:30 onboarding appointment for Jun Park with Elena (neighbor) attending to support daily readings from 07:00 to 07:15' for c in commitments) or any(c['type'] == 'scheduling' and c['target'] == 'Tuesday 15:30 onboarding appointment' and c['detail'] == 'Confirm Tuesday 15:30 onboarding appointment for Jun Park with Elena (neighbor) attending to support daily readings from 07:00 to 07:15' for c in commitments) or any(c['type'] == 'schedule_onboarding' and c['target'] == 'Jun Park' and c['detail'] == 'Confirm Tuesday 15:30 onboarding appointment with Elena (neighbor/caregiver) documented as support person for daily monitoring' for c in commitments) or any(c['type'] == 'onboarding' and c['target'] == 'Jun Park' and c['detail'] == 'Schedule Tuesday 15:30 onboarding appointment; neighbor Elena to attend and check transmitted readings every morning 07:00-07:15.' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: decisions['authorization_status'] in ['approved', 'Approved', 'APPROVED'] and decisions['authorization_code'] == 'RPM-7314' and decisions['authorization_days'] == 30

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The priority-tier assignment changes the selected patient from an unresolved choice among three referrals to Jun Park and supplies the required justification for that selection.

The medication-titration requirement changes the equipment fields from unspecified devices to exactly a Bluetooth blood-pressure cuff with twice-daily readings and a Bluetooth scale with daily readings.
Elena's confirmed availability changes onboarding from an unspecified appointment to Tuesday 15:30 and establishes the associated daily 07:00-07:15 monitoring plan.
The payer record changes authorization from unresolved to approved with the exact code RPM-7314 and the exact 30-day duration.
